events.title: Safari 6 released
events.summary: Apple released [Safari] 6 on July 25, 2012 with [OS] X Mountain Lion — featuring a unified [URL]/search bar, iCloud Tabs, and offline Reading List.
events.about: [Safari] 6 dropped Windows support and focused on the Mac and [iOS] ecosystem: iCloud sync let users continue browsing across devices; the combined omnibar matched [Chrome]'s UX. It was the last [Safari] version many Mac users saw before the annual [OS]-tied releases.

narrative.whyChosen: [Safari] 6 tied browsing tightly to Apple's cloud and device ecosystem.
narrative.whyImportant: iCloud Tabs previewed cross-device continuity that became an Apple platform pillar.
narrative.problemSolved: Mac users wanted seamless handoff between [iPhone], [iPad], and desktop browsing.

sources.title: Apple — OS X Mountain Lion available today (July 25, 2012)
